reasoning_content: This layer supports EPSG:4326. The style names (default/vollflaechig/transparent) are probably the styles. Let's grab the Style block for rp_plan and render with an explicit style.

action.command:
python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/wmscaps.xml').read()
i=d.find('rp_plan')
j=d.find('</Layer>',i)
seg=d[i:j]
styles=re.findall(r'<Style>.*?<Default><Name>([^<]+)</Name>',seg,re.S)
print('styles:',styles)
"
echo "=== GetMap with explicit style ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/wms4.png -w "HTTP %{http_code} content-type=%{content_type} size=%{size_download}\n" -m 120 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&version=1.3.0&request=GetMap&crs=EPSG:4326&bbox=47.2,5.7,55.1,15.1&width=300&height=300&layers=rp_plan&styles=default&format=image%2Fpng&transparent=TRUE"
file /tmp/wms4.png; head -c 300 /tmp/wms4.png
